1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __that is not accessible without the working channel__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a surgical procedure requiring access through the working channel__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered directly to a target site within the brain through the working channel__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device is positioned between tissue layers within the brain__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __and maintaining the device in position during radial expansion__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the integrity of the working channel__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a stent structure__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that requires direct access to the target site__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a procedure requiring access through the reinforced working channel__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered directly to a target tissue site through the reinforced working channel__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining separation of the tissue layers during the procedure__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while preserving the working channel for continued access__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to introducing the medical element__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __requiring direct access to a target site__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a procedure requiring access through the stent-reinforced working channel__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered directly to a target tissue site through the stent-reinforced working channel__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __and maintaining the multi-body device structure during insertion and expansion__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __prior to introducing the medical element__.
